title: Code, extraction outputs, and analyses for: How Much Corroboration Do LLM Extractors Realise? Source-Counted Noisy-OR Aggregation Across Sentences and Documents
description:
Code, prompts, configurations, language-model extraction outputs, analysis results, pre-registration history (decision and evidence logs), and a reproduction script for the article of the same title, submitted to Knowledge-Based Systems.

The raw third-party corpora (CaRB, DocRED, BioRED) are not redistributed; they are available from their original releases. The synthetic product data are regenerated deterministically by the code.
